items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: We were friends with Claude Kerr.

ctx.x: There's another guy who had a good band. Right, yeah. He had a very good band. A guy named Henry Hardin had a band too.
His band used to play at the rhythm club too. Hardin? H-A-R-D-I-N? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Were you first friends with Claude Kerr? Well we just, you know, we had a good band. Yeah.
